notes: Policy includes separate sections for Colorado, Kansas, and Utah with different FPL thresholds and copay/charge percentages. The policy states that CommonSpirit Health Mountain Region treats emergent and urgent patients regardless of their ability to pay or coverage status. The policy mentions that if an insured patient is not eligible for assistance, the hospital is committed to offering reasonable payment plan options and will allow for at least 30 days past the payment due date before pursuing collections. The policy references compliance with PPACA, Internal Revenue Code Section 501(r), and Colorado Senate Bill 14-50. The policy includes covered facilities and providers addenda. The policy does not explicitly define 'underinsured' in the provided text, so no rules use that variable. The policy does not mention assets or income verification procedures in the eligibility determination, so those are not modeled as requirements.
